outgoing.name: Chicago
outgoing.excerpt: In 1883, the D&H borrowed the boiler to display at the Exposition of Railway Appliances in Chicago, IL.

outgoing.name: Lion
outgoing.excerpt: The locomotive earned the name Lion from the picture of a lion's face that was painted on the front of the locomotive by its builder.

outgoing.name: England
outgoing.excerpt: …one of the first locomotives to operate outside of England, where it was manufactured in 1828.
